15.problem: Let \(P_0\) be a regular icosahedron with an edge length of 17 units. For each nonnegative integer \(n\), recursively construct \(P_{n+1}\) from \(P_n\) by performing the following procedure on each face of \(P_n\): glue a regular tetrahedron to that face such that three of the vertices of the tetrahedron are the midpoints of the three adjacent edges of the face, and the last vertex extends outside of \(P_n\). Express the number of square units in the surface area of \(P_{17}\) in the form \[\frac{u^v \cdot w\sqrt{x}}{y^z},\] where \(u\), \(v\), \(w\), \(x\), \(y\), and \(z\) are integers, all greater than or equal to 2, that satisfy the following conditions: the only perfect square that evenly divides \(x\) is 1, the \(\gcd\) of \(u\) and \(y\) is 1, and neither \(u\) nor \(y\) divides \(w\). Answers written in any other form will not be considered correct!
15.solutions: No official solution was published for this problem.
